## Outcome and scope

Link the plan slice, requirements and specifications. State the smallest useful result and explicit exclusions.

## Hypothesis and acceptance

Expected benefit, simpler alternative and behavior tests that would falsify it. Include failure/cancellation/authority cases where relevant.

## Evidence and critical review

Actual verification required, review record and release gate. A checkbox needs evidence, not just source code.
